meta.description: Excel>JSON Y2026 (251 items, 5 sheets) - fuzzy token search + search_items()

specs.name: lookup_price
specs.description:
Search price from embedded JSON.
Use SHORT keywords like "ร่มโค้ก 36 นิ้ว", "Sale kit A4", "A4 230g".
Do NOT pass long descriptions. Break compound requests into separate calls.

specs.name: search_items
specs.description:
Fuzzy search for items by keyword(s).
Use short Thai or English keywords like "ร่มโค้ก", "A4", "เสื้อโปโล".
Returns top matching items with scores, categories, and prices.
For composite jobs (e.g. print+bind+laminate), call multiple times with different keywords.
